data.name: Counterspell Mastery
data.description: At 6th level, you gain Improved Counterspell as a bonus feat. You may attempt to counterspell an opponent's spell once per day as an immediate action (instead of a readied action). You must use a spell at least one level higher than the spell being countered to use this ability. You can use this ability %1 times per day.|CounterspellCounterspellMasteryTimes
